scores.notes: Shows the priest beside the bronze altar dropping the bird's feathers and crop into the ash pile in the tabernacle courtyard, avoiding gore. Full-bleed painting with coherent anatomy, no lettering, and no human figure of God.

Depicts Moses gesturing from Mount Horeb as the encamped Israelites prepare to journey onward, with no human figure of God in the mountain cloud. Unpainted white paper shows at the upper-right sky edge, which is accepted for this style.

Captures Saul staggering as a sudden shaft of light shines from the sky around him on the road approaching Damascus, with his companions recoiling at right. Anatomy, framing, and scene details are coherent with no lettering.

A stray disembodied black shoe protrudes from beneath an empty section of the table at bottom center-left with no leg or figure attached. Unpainted white paper also shows in the upper-right sky edge, which is accepted.

Unreadable handwritten pseudo-script squiggles are visible on the slip of paper Holmes holds in the center and on a sheet on the desk, along with dial marks on the mantel clock. Otherwise accurately depicts Lestrade leaning over to dispute which side of the paper Holmes is examining.

Shows Jesus standing in the boat with outstretched arm rebuking the wind and waves as light breaks through the storm clouds while the disciples watch. Full-bleed oil painting with sound anatomy and no lettering.

In the center-left background hoist, one worker holds a boulder overhead directly against the taut diagonal ropes suspending a lower stone block, while a stray rope rises from the lower block and terminates in mid-air against the tower. Unpainted white sky at the top-left edge is accepted.

Accurately illustrates David crouching by the brook to gather smooth stones with his staff, sling, and shepherd's pouch while Goliath and his shield-bearer approach across the stream. Clean anatomy and coherent composition with no lettering.
Shows Ezekiel raising his hand to prophesy over the valley of dry bones with no human figure of Yahweh drawn. The left, right, and bottom edges vignette into unpainted white paper, which is accepted.

Depicts the cloud resting upon the tabernacle in the middle of the valley while the Israelites remain encamped in tents around it. Full-bleed painting with coherent figures and setting and no lettering.

Shows Holmes holding the sparkling blue carbuncle up against the Baker Street window light while Watson observes from his armchair. Full-bleed painting with accurate anatomy, no screen-adaptation likenesses or props, and no lettering.

Handles a grim verse solemnly by showing the Levite holding a knife over his concubine's completely shrouded body inside his stone house, avoiding gore. Full-bleed painting with sound anatomy and no lettering.

At center-right, the March Hare's left coat sleeve extends horizontally behind the Dormouse's head while a separate furry hand protrudes downward beside his waistcoat without a coherent forearm. Otherwise accurately shows Alice in a large armchair at the tea table.

Fittingly illustrates Watson's opening reflection on Irene Adler by showing Holmes examining her photograph with a magnifying glass in Baker Street while Watson watches. Clean line-and-wash art with coherent anatomy and no lettering.

Breaks the depiction rule by drawing the crowned King and Knave on the right as flat oblong playing cards instead of people in court-card dress, and mixes conventional wooden mallets and wire wickets with Alice's flamingo and card-soldier arches. Spade and heart pips appear on the card bodies and Queen's gown; white sky at the upper edges is accepted.

A robed human-shaped figure with visible shoulders, torso, and draped legs sits on God's throne in the center, breaking the depiction rule and neverDrawn restriction. In addition, a prominent narrator figure with a staff kneels in the center foreground though the verse does not call for him.

Accurately depicts Holmes pulling Watson into the Baker Street room while shutting the door as the stout, fiery-red-haired Jabez Wilson half-rises from his armchair. Full-bleed painting with sound anatomy and no lettering.
Shows Peter taking the lame beggar by the right hand to raise him at the temple gate with John beside them and bystanders looking on. Hands, feet, and architecture are coherent with no lettering.

Presents a unified fresco-style genealogy composition linking Abraham at left, King David in the center beneath a grapevine, and the infant Jesus with Mary and Joseph at right for Matthew 1:1. Halos are plain with no inscriptions, and anatomy is sound.

Accurately depicts Hatherley with his bandaged thumb pointing excitedly toward the burning whitewashed house and fire engines while Holmes and Watson stand beside him among onlookers. Subtle unpainted paper spots along the bottom edge are accepted.

Illustrates the three generations named in Ruth 4:22—elderly Obed seated left, Jesse gesturing in the center, and young David with a shepherd's crook at right—outside a Judean stone house. Full-bleed painting with sound anatomy and no lettering.
Shows the disciples stepping ashore from the boat with their net of fish to see Jesus beside the charcoal fire laid with fish and bread. Full-bleed painting with natural anatomy and no lettering.

Shows frantic disciples waking Jesus on the cushion in the stern while waves crash over the boat and others bail water and cling to the rigging. Full-bleed painting with coherent anatomy and no lettering.

An extra disembodied pink four-toed paw protrudes upward from the tablecloth just below the Dormouse (whose two paws already hold its teacup), while the teapot at lower right merges with a slice of bread and oversized furry feet sit beneath the Dormouse's chair. Unpainted white edges are accepted.

Two extra crowned white-haired kings in court-card robes stand in the lower-left and lower-right foreground alongside the King of Hearts already seated on the throne. Playing-card heart pips and a corner 'K' index appear on the King's card front, with heart pips also on court robes.

Accurately shows Alice seated indignantly in a large armchair at one end of the long tea table while the Hatter, sleeping Dormouse, and March Hare crowd together at the far corner under a tree. Unpainted white paper along the outer and bottom margins is accepted.

Rows of unreadable pseudo-script squiggles are visible on the printed slip Watson holds up at center-left, on multiple papers across the foreground desk, and on the paper in Holmes's lap, alongside tick marks on the mantel clock. Otherwise accurately depicts the narrated moment with clean anatomy.

Depicts King Darius pressing his signet ring into clay over the stone slab covering the lions' den while his lords hold their cylinder seals ready and guards look on. Unpainted white sky at the top-left edge is accepted.

Shows Ezekiel prophesying with outstretched hand over a vast valley of dry skulls and bones beneath rays of light breaking through storm clouds, with no human figure of Yahweh drawn. Full-bleed painting with sound anatomy and no lettering.

Scale is contradictory and breaks the size-clarity rule: Alice stands tiny beside a giant mushroom and massive trees, yet a miniature cottage with a door at lower right is shorter than her waist. Additionally, the Caterpillar is drawn with a fully human man's face rather than an animal face.

Shows Daniel watching from the right ('I watched') as thrones are placed around a dais bearing a throne of blazing flames and burning wheels with no human figure drawn for the Ancient of Days. Full-bleed painting with coherent crowd and no lettering.

Accurately illustrates Holmes kneeling with lantern and magnifying glass to inspect the bank cellar flagstones while Watson watches and Mr. Merryweather perches solemnly on a crate. Vignetted white paper at the corners and edges is accepted.

Shows the father embracing his ragged, barefoot returning son while directing servants bringing the best robe, a ring on a cloth, and sandals, without inserting an extra speaker figure. Unpainted white sky at the top-left edge is accepted.

Alice's left arm extends behind her and fuses directly into the King's white-gloved left hand clutching her skirt, and a background player at far right uses a wooden mallet, white ball, and wire hoop. Heart/spade pips and corner indices ('g'/'9', 'A', '10', '6') appear on the King's tunic and background card soldiers; white corners are accepted.

Depicts Moses standing on a rocky ledge before cloud-ringed Mount Horeb gesturing onward as Israelite families, livestock, and packs travel toward the distant plains, with no human figure of Yahweh. Full-bleed painting with sound anatomy and no lettering.
